Sawyer made his National debut with 256th place and the evergreen Eddie Short completed the side with 290 - non-scorers being Joe Dooley (326) and an injury-stricken Ken Miller (401).
Walker showed much improved form to finish a good 6th, but although we had Shippen (9th) and Sawyer (12th) we could only manage third place with six to score, and second with ten to score.

Sawyer showed a good turn of speed for a man who does "double marathon" stuff and maintained our position, but Masters, whose first race this was for 4 months because of injury, was forced to give a place on the run in for the final change-over.
Our "B", "C", and "D" teams also produced some good performances notably from Maclean, Sawyer and Forey, and all but the "C" team closed in.
Belgrave were without Sawyer and Linstead, but Denis Jones ran very well and with the support of Norman Stairs and Len Bishop, we were placed third.
CENTRE RIGHT: Walker, Black, Sawyer, Thresher and North head the field at 2½ miles in the Club 7 miles 6hampionship for the "Blackstaffe" shield.

He was 2nd to Hogan in the Insurance '6' with 30:09.5 (Sawyer was 6th in 31:02), and in August, finished only 3 secs. behind Tony Milner in the Walton A.C. 6 miles Championship with 29:35 - only 7 secs. outside his best ever.

Pat forfeited a place in the "Brighton" team by his unfortunate retirement, which was caused by a week of indifferent health but with Gerry North, Thresher and Sawyer to come in with the first nine, none of our first 12 could be reasonably displaced.
